taxonomy.mixed_sentiment: Both praise and complaint; overall verdict depends on weighting of aspects
taxonomy.neutral_boundary: Mild/lukewarm or 'average' evaluation near the neutral boundary
taxonomy.negation_or_contrast: Polarity reversed by negation or a contrastive clause ('but', 'however')
taxonomy.implicit_sentiment: Sentiment implied by facts/events (prices, waiting, incidents) without evaluative words
taxonomy.rating_text_mismatch: Text polarity clearly differs from the star-derived label
taxonomy.sarcasm_irony: Literal wording opposite to intended meaning
taxonomy.short_or_uninformative: Too short / generic to contain decisive cues
taxonomy.domain_vocabulary: Decisive cue is rare/domain-specific vocabulary (dish names, local terms)
taxonomy.non_standard_language: Machine-translation artefacts, misspellings or non-standard orthography (e.g. dotless ı)
